meta.title: Agent roster
meta.description: A profile-wide roster of role templates with one-click team building: a "+"-menu member spawn flow (pick a template, name the member, optionally choose a model and an initial task), reusable AI-assisted template drafting that only proposes, roster_template_save / roster_template_list agent tools, and a roster manager card on the Plugins page. Members are ordinary subagents that inherit the session model by default.
